rationales.authenticity: Dialect and phrasing are good ('Aye, sure 'tis', 'tis all anyone's been talkin''); period-authentic skepticism.
rationales.character: Village gossip and concern appropriately conveyed; midwife's interest in strangers fits social role.

rationales.responsiveness: Directly confirms knowledge of the stranger and shares village gossip.
